# Scoped null in a typed constructor delegation

An owned generic constructor forwards an original class-formal seed and invariant
carrier while supplying the original decoded null for another Object-bounded
class-formal input. A second delegation retains two boolean literals. Four
frozen constructor routes compare 96 cases twice with source and SDK carrier
declarations, checking default nulls, identities, aliases, partial writes,
constructor/callback order, late casts and exact runtime/error/checked failures.
The class also implements iterable, iterator and serialization contracts. Every
generated source and original metadata entry, including the methodless carrier,
is compiled and audited. Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature
controls guard the scope and origin proof. Only owned classes execute.
